key_insight: Injecting logical stabilizer and global magic states enables addressable, parallel universal fault-tolerant computation in high-rate concatenated self-dual codes.
engineering_relevance: The architecture combines logical gates with error correction through teleportation, offering a route to lower-overhead quantum computation.
method: Concatenate small-distance, high-rate self-dual CSS codes.
Prepare logical CSS stabilizer states using flag-at-origin and global magic states using concatenated cultivation.
Consume resources via Steane-QEC or Knill-QEC teleportation, requiring at most 12 resource states per T-depth layer.
evidence_signal: Benchmarks of resource preparation for several two-level concatenations of H and Hamming codes report at least a tenfold spacetime reduction for concatenated cultivation versus surface-code cultivation.
watch_item: The reported advantage concerns resource-state preparation; end-to-end hardware overhead and performance require further validation.
paper_title: Injection is all you need: parallel universal logic in high-rate concatenated self-dual codes
